en_title: World of Warcraft Forever's Launch Was Running on Over 200,000 Gigabytes of RAM
cn_title: 《魔兽世界Forever》上线时使用了超过200,000 GB内存
opus_summary: 《魔兽世界Forever》上线后，暴雪表示服务器使用了3,924台虚拟机、251,136 GB内存和70,480个CPU核心。尽管玩家众多，服务器依然相当稳定，多名玩家也称赞此次上线过程顺畅。

paragraphs.en: World of Warcraft Forever launched last night, and while there were a ton of people playing, the servers were remarkably stable . It turns out that Blizzard dedicated a ton of resources to making sure those servers were solid.
paragraphs.cn: 《魔兽世界Forever》昨晚上线，虽然有大量玩家游玩，但服务器格外稳定。原来，Blizzard投入了大量资源来确保服务器稳定。

paragraphs.en: Last night, after the game launched, Blizzard tweeted out a meme from its World of Warcraft account, with a Gnome tapping a car with the WoW Forever logo, with a caption saying: "*Slaps Roof of WoW: Forever* This baby is running on: 3,924 Virtual Machines, 251,136 GB of Memory, 70,480 CPU Cores." That's a huge amount of memory, and it seems to have paid off with the smoothest Blizzard launch I've seen in years.
paragraphs.cn: 昨晚游戏上线后，Blizzard通过《魔兽世界》账号发布了一张迷因图，图中一个侏儒拍着一辆带有《WoW Forever》标志的汽车，配文写道：「*拍拍《WoW: Forever》的车顶* 这宝贝运行时使用了：3,924台虚拟机、251,136 GB内存、70,480个CPU核心。」这是数量惊人的内存，投入似乎也得到了回报：这是我多年来见过的最流畅的一次Blizzard游戏上线。

paragraphs.en: Blizzard's post bragging about the sheer amount of memory in its servers comes just a week after Sam Altman said in a podcast that it was "quite terrible" for people to have RAM in their own computers, rather than in a data center. Of course, he did later walk it back , instead claiming that he had "been arguing for the world to ramp up memory production for a long time." Still, that's 251,136GB of RAM that's dedicated to running an incredible MMO, rather than powering yet another data center.
paragraphs.cn: 就在Blizzard发帖炫耀其服务器内存数量之庞大的一周前，Sam Altman在一档播客中表示，人们在自己的电脑里装内存，而不是将内存放在数据中心，是「相当糟糕的」。当然，他后来收回了这番话，转而声称自己「长期以来一直在呼吁全球提高内存产量」。不过，这251,136GB内存是专门用来运行一款出色的MMO，而不是为又一个数据中心提供算力。

paragraphs.en: Blizzard Executive Producer and Vice President for World of Warcraft Holly Longdale also posted celebrating the smooth launch, and said "this launch was crazier than the insanity we imagined but thankfully the team built plans and contingencies. They are incredible imo." And, while we likely will never know just how many people logged into Forever for the launch, I can say firsthand that there were hundreds of characters in the starting zone right at 6pm EST, so the team definitely deserves recognition for holding everything together.
paragraphs.cn: Blizzard执行制作人兼《魔兽世界》副总裁Holly Longdale也发帖庆祝游戏顺利上线，并表示：「这次上线比我们想象中的疯狂还要疯狂，但幸好团队制定了计划和应急预案。我认为他们太厉害了。」虽然我们可能永远不会知道上线时究竟有多少人登录了《Forever》，但我可以凭亲身经历说，美国东部标准时间下午6点整，初始区域就有数百个角色，所以团队维持了一切正常运转，绝对值得称赞。

paragraphs.en: Even on the WoW forums, which are hardly a bastion of positivity, there are a number of threads with players praising WoW Forever for being one of the smoothest WoW launches of all time . On X/Twitter, WoW streamer Darth Microtransaction posted, "I don’t know how they did it, but they did. World of Warcraft Forever launch was the smoothest launch I’ve seen. Almost 0 Que[ue]. 0 dc, and no lag."
paragraphs.cn: 即使在向来算不上充满正面情绪的《WoW》论坛上，也有不少帖子里的玩家称赞《WoW Forever》是《WoW》史上最流畅的上线之一。在X上，《WoW》主播Darth Microtransaction发帖说：「我不知道他们是怎么做到的，但他们做到了。《魔兽世界Forever》是我见过的最流畅的一次上线。几乎不用排队。没有掉线，也没有延迟。」

paragraphs.en: This launch was a solid start to a game that's going to take most people weeks to go through. The beta was huge on its own, despite being limited to just level 30. And, even when folks knew their characters would get deleted, so many people played the beta that developers commented on it for being the "craziest numbers [they've] seen." And now that the full game is here, it's going to be interesting to see what players discover, and what gets added in the future. Because, according to Blizzard, there's potential to visit some fan favorite locations from future expansions , too.
paragraphs.cn: 这次上线为这款大多数人需要花上数周才能玩完的游戏开了个好头。尽管测试版的等级上限只有30级，但其内容本身就十分庞大。而且，即便人们知道自己的角色会被删除，参加测试的玩家依然多到让开发者称其为「［他们］见过的最疯狂的数字」。如今完整版游戏已经推出，玩家会发现什么、未来又会加入什么内容，都将很有意思。因为据Blizzard称，玩家也有可能前往后续资料片中一些深受粉丝喜爱的地点。
